workarounds.symptom: Sessions sidebar offers one-click Resume for sessions interrupted months ago (no age limit on the interrupted count)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: leave week-old interrupted sessions out of the bulk Resume. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_resume_all.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/slot_projection.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/state.py. **Goal:** The Sessions sidebar stops offering to restart chats whose last turn was cut short more than a week ago. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35861)

workarounds.symptom: Codex commands fail inside Linux namespace sandbox despite working AppArmor profile
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: run codex within the existing host sandbox. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/client_permissions.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/codex.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/session_handle_permissions.py. > Taken over by @buluoray to drive it green (rebased on main, fallback added, re-verified). Original work and design by @brentlee-personal, credited with `Co-authored-by`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/29127)

workarounds.symptom: Script cron: spawn_run through ctx.call_tool is refused with 409 memory_unavailable (a cron:<id> key never gets a published memory mode)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cron): admit a script cron's key for its spawn calls during the run. Target files: src/kiro_crew/slack/gateway_runtime/cron_fire.py, test/test_cron_script_spawn_memory_mode.py, docs/system-specs/modules/learn-cron-dashboard.md. **Goal:** A script cron can start subagents with `ctx.call_tool("kirocrew-core", "spawn_run", ...)`, the same way a message cron's turn can. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35175)

workarounds.symptom: Loading the embedding model silences the whole process: the --json-ready line and log lines are lost
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: load the embedding model without silencing the process. Target files: src/kiro_crew/embeddings.py, src/kiro_crew/embeddings_native.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_shared_wire.py. **Goal:** Loading the embedding model no longer silences the rest of the process, so the gateway's `--json-ready` line, log lines and tracebacks written meanwhile always arrive. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35444)

workarounds.symptom: cli.sh on a nearly full disk: no free-space check, fails with a raw ensurepip error, and leaves 120 MB behind
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(install): check free space first and remove a failed first venv. Target files: cli.sh, test/test_installer_disk_space.py, test/test_installer_distro.py. **Goal:** On a nearly full disk, the one-line install stops before it downloads anything with a plain "not enough space" message, says the disk filled up in plain words when a step still runs out of room, and leaves no half-built venv behind. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35216)

workarounds.symptom: deepseek: lower-case agent.deepseek_env names pass the reserved-name refusal on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: tighten a harness environment name check on windows. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/deepseek.py, test/test_acp_deepseek_backend_vault.py. **Goal:** On Windows, a provider key mapping for the DeepSeek Harness cannot name one of Kiro Crew's own variables by spelling it in a different letter case. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/33724)

workarounds.symptom: App SDK useChatSession stays "loading" forever if the new session never shows in the lookup
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(app-sdk): make useChatSession ready from the slot create returns. Target files: website/src/app-sdk/useChatSession.ts, website/src/i18n/locales/bn.json, website/src/i18n/locales/de.json. **Goal:** An app that creates its chat session with `useChatSession` gets a ready session as soon as the create succeeds, instead of a spinner that never ends. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35248)

workarounds.symptom: `kirocrew service install` needs sudo; Next steps don't say so and there is no fallback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: say service install needs sudo and name a no-sudo fallback. Target files: src/kiro_crew/service/linux_install.py, cli.sh, test/test_installer_restart_hint.py. **Goal:** A Linux user without sudo learns from the installer that `kirocrew service install` needs sudo, and a failed install tells them how to keep Kiro Crew running without it. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/33743)

workarounds.symptom: Remote crew diagnosis, git divergence and the embeddings pip check kill their child only on timeout, so a cancel (instance edit, gateway shutdown) leaves the ssh or git child running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: kill a probe, git or pip child when its call is cancelled. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/memory_embeddings.py, src/kiro_crew/git_divergence.py, src/kiro_crew/instances/diagnostics.py. **Goal:** A cancelled remote crew diagnosis, update-check git count or embeddings pip run stops its child process instead of leaving it running with no owner. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34496)

workarounds.symptom: Spawn refused with the parent agent named when an unrelated project agent spec does not parse
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(subagent): name the unreadable spec files when a spawn is refused fail-closed. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/messaging.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/messaging_api/spawn.py, src/kiro_crew/subagent.py. `parent_spawn_allowlists` answers `None` when no readable spec declares the parent agent's name and some spec file in the agents directory cannot be read. `_vet_parent_available_agents` then refuses the spawn. The refusal names only the parent agent, for example "the parent agent 'kirocrew' spec could not... (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31462)

workarounds.symptom: deploy_artifact never offers the human override for a scan block, and drops refusal hints
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deploy): let deploy_artifact read the route's scan block and hints. Target files: src/kiro_crew/mcp_core_parts/gateway.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_tools/artifacts.py, test/conftest.py. **Goal:** When a deploy is refused, the `deploy_artifact` tool tells the agent what actually happened: a scan block it can hand to a person to override, a hard block with its reason, or a refusal with its retry hint and command. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34648)

workarounds.symptom: Cron-born chat tabs vanish on every gateway restart: restore reads dashboard_cron-<id>.jsonl, a name never written
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): restore cron chat tabs by their written transcript name. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils_slots.py, test/test_cron_slot_restore_name.py. **Goal:** Keep cron-born chat tabs in the sidebar across a gateway restart instead of silently dropping them. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31309)

workarounds.symptom: Observability: record what a cut turn was waiting on, and why a Stop or send did nothing
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): record usage for a turn ended before EVENT_COMPLETE. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_runner.py, test/test_abnormal_turn_usage_row_15013.py, test/test_turn_duration_recorded.py. **Goal:** A chat turn that ends abnormally (the 6-hour turn ceiling, the Stop button, or another recovery path) records its credits in the usage store, instead of billing zero. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/15878)
